Since 0.1.9. The major version stays 0.

### Home
When the grid slides, the ribbon bead rides its strand. Each trip still starts at the left edge. A long slide during a trip can carry the bead off the screen early (#396).

A finger drag keeps the focus ring on one whole tile, and the top screen stays with that tile. Once a quarter of that tile has slid past an edge, the cursor steps along its row onto the next tile still on screen (#397). While a finger holds the grid, and while it settles where you let go, the ring hops from tile to tile. A d-pad step or a tap still glides. A ring fading at the edge keeps its glow (#397).

### RomM
While a tile downloads, both screens stay on, so the screen timeout does not sleep the device. Pressing power or closing the lid does not stall the download right away. The hold ends when the download ends, and it lets go after six hours (#398).

A download that keeps receiving bytes does not give up. Once some of a file has arrived, a dropped connection is tried again for about a minute. A failed certificate check, a cleartext connection, or a redirect the app will not follow still stops it. A download that never receives anything still stops after a few tries. A game, each add-on, and a firmware file count their own progress (#398).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads Home shortcuts and exported `.steam`, `.epic`, `.gog`, `.amazon`, and `.pcgame` files. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
- Android games launched from Foldcade don't record play history, so they don't appear in Recent or Most played.
